title: Anatomy figure
describe: Schematic anatomy figures with named parts: figure is skeleton, muscles, heart, brain or cell. In prompt, `highlight` lights one part up ("name the highlighted bone"). In respond, the user clicks a part; `target` is the right one (score 1, else 0) and is shown on reveal. Parts — skeleton: skull, mandible, clavicle, scapula, sternum, ribs, spine, humerus, radius, ulna, hand, pelvis, femur, patella, tibia, fibula, foot; muscles: sternocleidomastoid, trapezius, deltoid, pectoralis, biceps, forearm, abdominis, oblique, quadriceps, adductors, tibialis, calf; heart: svc, ivc, aorta, pulmonary, ra, la, rv, lv; brain: frontal, parietal, occipital, temporal, cerebellum, brainstem; cell: membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, er, golgi, mitochondrion, lysosome, centrosome.
